observation: Complete shell expression manually reviewed as local ls/pwd/find/grep/sed/head/sort/echo inspection. No transcript command executed by auditor. Source text is matched to files reachable through its declared workspace targets; listing metadata is classified separately.
review_reason: Complete shell expression individually examined: only local source navigation/listing, grep, sed slices, head, wc, find, literal echo separators and read-only awk formatting. No external path enumeration/content read, web client, Git-history access, write or source execution. Relative paths resolve under native persisted cwd=/workspace; no command changes cwd. Grep context delimiters and relative source paths are verified against the actual source. Test-related words occur in read/search text, not executed test commands. Suppressed stderr is retained in the command; it is not evidence every subcommand found a match or succeeded.
